results.concept: Error 404: Sleep Not Found - minimalist design for developers

prompt_data.main_prompt: Design a minimalist T-shirt for DreamShaperXL Turbo featuring an 'Error 404: Sleep Not Found' concept. The design should incorporate clean typography and a monochromatic color palette with accent colors. Include geometric shapes in the composition, reflecting a modern tech aesthetic.
prompt_data.negative_prompt: Avoid overly complex designs that may not reproduce well on T-shirt fabric. Limit the use of intricate details or patterns as they might appear pixelated when printed.

results.concept: Level Up Your Style - retro gaming inspired design

prompt_data.main_prompt: The T-shirt design features a retro gaming theme inspired by the nostalgic pixel art culture of the '80s and '90s. The central image is a stylized, 8-bit version of the iconic DreamShaperXL Turbo logo, rendered in vibrant neon colors against a dark background. The composition includes the original logo elements in a visually appealing arrangement, with an emphasis on clean lines and well-defined shapes. The design also incorporates typographic details such as retro-inspired font choices and tasteful use of negative space. This T-shirt design is perfect for print-on-demand production, offering a unique and eye-catching item for fans of retro gaming culture.
prompt_data.negative_prompt: Avoid generic or overly simplified designs. Keep composition clear and avoid overcrowding. Ensure adequate contrast between text and background to maintain readability. Minimize blurriness and pixelation, which can be problematic in print-on-demand production.

results.concept: Fresh Threads - bold urban streetwear design

prompt_data.main_prompt: Create a bold and fresh urban streetwear design for ComfyUI featuring graffiti-style graphics and contemporary elements. The T-shirt should have a high contrast color palette with bold accent colors. Design a unique composition that showcases the urban streetwear aesthetic while maintaining readability of any text. Avoid low-quality images, poorly executed typography, and overuse of graphic elements that don't work well on T-shirts.
prompt_data.negative_prompt: Common issues include poor image resolution, lack of contrast in color palette, low-quality typography, and excessive use of graphic elements. Ensure the design is suitable for print-on-demand production without compromising quality or readability.
